howWeWork.description: A clear delivery process, from initial design through release and support.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Define user journeys, interface designs and system architecture. Agree on requirements before development begins.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Build in focused sprints, with code reviews and regular demos to track progress.

steps.title: Testing
steps.description: Test features throughout delivery, with functional checks and regression testing before release.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.description: Plan the release, monitor key workflows and agree on support as your product moves into use.
